<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type SupportChannelsProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    channels: Feature[];
    open: string;
    layout?: "grid" | "list";
    cols?: "1-2" | "1-3";
    action?: "link" | "none";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Card from "../primitives/card/card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    channels,
    open,
    layout = "grid",
    cols = "1-3",
    action = "link",
    tone = "default",
  }: SupportChannelsProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone}>
  <Grid cols={(((layout as string) === "list") ? "1" : cols)} class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
    {#each channels as c (c.id)}
      <Card
        variant="default"
        class={cn("h-full", (((layout as string) === "list") ? "flex-row items-center" : ""))}
        data-testid="item"
      >
        <CardContent class={cn("flex flex-1 gap-4", (((layout as string) === "list") ? "items-center" : "flex-col"))}>
          <LucideIcon name={c.icon} size={24} />
          <Stack gap="2" class="flex-1">
            <Title as={3} size="base" weight="bold">
              {c.title}
            </Title>
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {c.text}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          {#if ((action as string) === "link")}
            <Link href="#/" variant="default" data-testid="open">
              {open}
            </Link>
          {/if}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    {/each}
  </Grid>
</SectionFrame>
